message:
fix(context): reject ambiguous persisted host metadata

Validate canonical unique host fields before JSON decoding can merge duplicate names or case aliases. Retained window/journal/frame/admission and checkpoint envelopes stay strict; arbitrary tool-result payloads and exact large numeric identifiers remain opaque. Reject corruption before reconciliation changes state, with content-free errors.

Fourteen real-store regressions failed before the fix on in-memory and SQLite. Full Go 1.26.4 runctx/assembly/SDK race suites pass; package coverage 86.1/83.7/100 percent. Independent-pool PostgreSQL corruption regressions and complete phase 269 smoke pass (14 OK, 0 SKIP, 0 FAIL). Scoped pinned lint, Markdown and whitespace checks pass. No format, dependency or retention-default changes. Whole final-tree release acceptance remains pending.
